footer.tagline: Medicine anytime anywhere. Online medical consultations with locally-registered doctors across Europe.
footer.newsletterDesc: Quarterly updates on new countries, doctors, and health topics. No spam.
footer.disclaimer: Online consultations are not a substitute for emergency care. If you need urgent help, call 112 or your local emergency number. Information on this website is general guidance; prescriptions, certificates, referrals and next steps depend on clinical assessment and are issued at the treating clinician's discretion.
